messages:
Rina: quick lunchtime poll: if our small retrieval model had a side hustle, what meme shop would it open? :thinking_face:
Theo: 'Context Curios' — sells vintage one-line prompts with artisan noise.
Aly: 'Prompt & Proper' — tea + prompt polishing. very niche. :tea:
Rina: MemeBot: poll created -> Options: Context Curios, Prompt & Proper, TinyResumeWriter, MicroMoodMix. Vote with :one: - :four:.
ops-bot: Poll results: 1) Context Curios 2) MicroMoodMix 3) Prompt & Proper 4) TinyResumeWriter
Theo: MicroMoodMix is my pick — makes playlists from commit messages. very emo. :headphones:
Aly: also want to patent the 'micro-resume' for tiny models: two-line CVs like "TinyEmbed — 3KB context manager. Specializes in remembering grocery lists."
Rina: can MemeBot make a sticker that says 'trained on artisanal receipts'?
MemeBot: sticker draft: "Made with locally sourced tokens." :printer:
Theo: usable for swag. but ops-bot: remind me the GIF policy again?
ops-bot: reminder: internal memes allowed. customer-facing assets need legal & brand review.
Aly: plan: deploy meme drop in #random on Friday. low-effort, high morale.
Rina: agreed. last thought: weekend persona for the model should prefer puns and short answers. sample system prompt: ```system: on weekends be pun-forward; answers <= 12 tokens; always include one plant pun if applicable.```
Theo: signed. ending thread before it becomes a roadmap. good chat! :seedling:
